item.title: Long awaited International District affordable housing project gets underway
item.description: ALBUQUERQUE, N.M. item.title: City of Albuquerque pays $800K to family of child killed in hit-and-run outside of River of Lights
item.description: ALBUQUERQUE, N.M. (KRQE) – The City of Albuquerque has reached a settlement with the parents of a seven-year-old who was killed in a hit-and-run outside of River of Lights. item.description: ALBUQUERQUE, N.M. (KRQE) – An Albuquerque woman who pretended to be a nurse, nearly killing a patient, is on the run.
